title: Delineating Oxidation Aspects of an Additively Manufactured Nanoprecipitation-Strengthened Al<sub>0.2</sub>Co<sub>1.5</sub>CrFeNi<sub>1.5</sub>Ti<sub>0.3</sub> High-Entropy Alloy.

recollection.intervention: Additive manufacturing followed by oxidation studies
recollection.structure: Nanoprecipitation-strengthened microstructure, likely with fine precipitates dispersed in a high-entropy matrix
recollection.mechanism: Oxidation behavior influenced by the distribution and composition of nanoprecipitates and the high-entropy matrix, possibly affecting oxide scale formation and growth kinetics
recollection.results: Main quantitative results likely include oxidation rates, oxide scale thickness, and possibly comparisons to conventionally processed alloys, but I do not remember the specific findings.

score.note: The recollection restates title-level themes: additive manufacturing, nanoprecipitation strengthening, and oxidation testing. It omits the key comparison between as-printed and 750°C/50 h aged states, the specific L12/L21 precipitates and trilayer Cr-rich oxide structure, the Cr-diffusion/passivation mechanism, and all reported kinetic exponents and activation energies.
